pages.text: The workshop where drones are built. It needs power: each assembly costs $(l)2,000 FE$() and takes 5 seconds.

$(li)Put a $(l:drone_systems/drone_frames)drone frame$(/l) in the $(l)frame$() slot (on the left). Insert it first: the other slots stay greyed out until there is a frame.$(br)$(li)Put $(l:drone_systems/modules)function modules$(/l) in the $(l)module$() column. The frame tier decides how many module slots are unlocked.
pages.title: How to build a drone

pages.text: $(li)Optionally put $(l:drone_systems/addons)addons$(/l) in the $(l)2x2 addon grid$(). Each slot holds a stack of the same addon; the counter above the grid shows how many you used out of the frame's limit.

$(li)Press $(l)Assemble$(). The drone takes shape as a $(l)hologram$() on the build plate, under the assembler's print head, unfolding as it is made. When the bar is full it flashes into the output slot: take the finished $(l:drone_systems/drones)Drone$(/l) from there.
A drone needs $(l)at least one module$(), and the same module cannot be installed twice.

To $(l)change a finished drone$(), put it back in the output slot with the other slots empty and press $(l)Disassemble$(): its parts return to their slots. Disassembling is free; assembling again costs the usual 2,000 FE.$(br2)Hover an empty slot to see what goes there.
The assembler accepts FE from any side, so place it next to a $(l:generators/combustion_generator)Combustion Generator$(/l) or connect it with cables.
